skill.name: permissions
skill.description: Use when implementing authorization, access control, RBAC, role-based permissions, guards, policies, row-level security, guest access, or protecting API endpoints. Covers Guard system, roles, permissions, policies, and data filtering.

generated_query: I'm building a blog application using bknd and need to set up access control. Anyone (even unauthenticated guests) should be able to read published posts, but only authenticated users can create new posts. Additionally, users should only be able to edit or delete their own posts. How can I configure this using the Guard and policies? I need a concrete example of roles and the required capability that implements this, including a guest role with a filter for published posts only, and an authenticated user role with ownership-based filters for updates and deletes.

edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the delete permission from the user role means authenticated users cannot delete their own posts, failing the query's requirement for ownership-based delete.
Changing the policy variable from 'auth.user.id' to 'auth.user.email' breaks ownership-based filtering, as the user query requires user ID matching.
